title: A smooth pair with local dimension drop one is Cartier
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and let $B,T,D$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $v:T\to B$ and $i:D\hookrightarrow T$ be morphisms, with $i$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and both $v$ and $v i$ smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Suppose that for every $y\in D$ the local rings satisfy
$$\dim\mathcal O_{T,i(y)}=\dim\mathcal O_{D,y}+1,$$
where dimension is the supremum of lengths of strict chains of prime ideals. Then every $y\in D$ has an open neighbourhood $U\subseteq T$ on which the ideal $\mathcal I_D|_U$ is generated by a single nonzerodivisor $f\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. Thus $D$ is an effective Cartier divisor [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle], including when $D$ is empty. No regularity or reducedness of $B$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0FUE, lemma-etale-local-structure; together with algebra.tex Tag 00KW, lemma-one-equation. Agent-stated codimension-one corollary, using finite-type Noetherianity.

proof.text: Choose affine neighbourhoods W in B of v(i(y)) and U in T inside v^-1(W). The closed immersion gives a surjection A = Gamma(T,U) -> C = Gamma(D,i^-1(U)) of smooth R = Gamma(B,W)-algebras by [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-iff-smooth-affine]. Its kernel lies in the prime of i(y). Apply [lem-pur-smooth-quotient-regular-sequence] to obtain a principal affine neighbourhood E of i(y) and a regular list f generating the extended kernel. The restriction formula for [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] identifies that kernel with i.ker.ideal E. This is precisely the regular-equation part of the first paragraph of Tag 0FUE; no etale coordinates are needed.

source.place: Tag 0FUE, first proof paragraph, using Divisors Tags 067U and 063J

proof.text: Finite type over the field makes both T and D locally Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. Their local rings are therefore Noetherian, and [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-finite-krull-dimension] makes their dimensions finite nonnegative integers. Identify the ambient stalk as the prime localization of Gamma(T,E) by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization]. Flatness of localization preserves weak regularity of f. Its germs lie in the maximal ideal because i(y) belongs to the support of i.ker, so the germ list is regular.

source.place: Tags 00KQ and 00CT; regularity under flat localization

proof.text: The proved source-library theorem Scheme.Hom.ker_stalkMap identifies the ideal generated by the germ list with the kernel of the surjective stalk map O_T,i(y) -> O_D,y. The first isomorphism theorem identifies its quotient with O_D,y. Apply [lem-trf-regular-sequence-dimension-formula] to the ambient stalk and the germ list. This gives dim O_D,y + length(f) = dim O_T,i(y). Compare with hcodim, express dim O_D,y as a natural number by finiteness, and cancel to get length(f)=1.

source.place: Tag 00KW iterated along the regular sequence; source-library ker_stalkMap implements localization of the quotient

proof.text: Write the one-element regular list as [s]. Weak regularity says multiplication by s is injective, hence s is a nonzerodivisor. Its ideal is i.ker.ideal E, giving the requested affine neighbourhood. For any x outside i(D), the support of i.ker is i(D) because i is a closed immersion. Choose an affine neighbourhood disjoint from this support; [lemma-nagata-ideal-unit-off-support] makes its ideal the unit ideal, generated by the nonzerodivisor 1. These two cases show i.ker is invertible everywhere. The equivalence isEffectiveCartierCenter_iff_isInvertible_ker from [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle] concludes. This also handles empty D.

source.place: Tag 0FUE, regular equations and the definition of an effective Cartier divisor

lean.statement: theorem Scheme.Hom.exists_regular_equation_and_isEffectiveCartierCenter_of_smooth (k : Type u) [Field k] {B T D : Scheme.{u}} (b : B ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (t : T ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (d : D ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType b] [QuasiCompact b] [LocallyOfFiniteType t] [QuasiCompact t] [LocallyOfFiniteType d] [QuasiCompact d] (v : T ⟶ B) (i : D ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] [Smooth v] [Smooth (i ≫ v)] (hcodim : ∀ y : D, ringKrullDim (T.presheaf.stalk (i y)) = ringKrullDim (D.presheaf.stalk y) + (1 : WithBot ℕ∞)) : (∀ y : D, ∃ U : T.affineOpens, i y ∈ U.1 ∧ ∃ f : Γ(T, U.1), f ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(T, U.1) ∧ i.ker.ideal U = Ideal.span {f}) ∧ IsEffectiveCartierCenter i
